battle.name: 格魯吉亞內戰
battle.brief: 中文維基〈戰爭列表〉所列的格魯吉亞內戰始於1991年，主要戰區位於南高加索，格魯吉亞政府軍與阿布哈茲亞及南奧塞梯亞地方武裝交火。所列裝備為英國蒸汽鐵甲艦，正式型號Steam ironclad，1865年即已服役，並非使用1991年後才列裝的型號。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦屬英國早期海軍的鐵甲主力艦，以蒸汽動力納入艦隊核心，負責艦隊防務、護航與海上火力支撐。

countries: 交戰各方可分四個層次。中央層是1991年4月9日宣告獨立的喬治亞共和國，及總統茲維亞德·加姆薩胡利亞領導的中央政府；地方層是1991年12月宣布自治或獨立、1992年8月26日正式脫離的南奧塞梯自治州與阿布哈茲自治共和國；外來層是俄羅斯聯邦高加索軍區所轄第62、第64集團軍的部隊，1992年3月15日進入南奧塞梯、攻占茨欣瓦利，1992年9月又以護送走廊為名進入阿布哈茲；最內層是喬治亞內部的權力競逐，內務部警察、國民警衛隊「國家守護者」與總統府支持者彼此對峙，1993年12月23日至24日首都的衝突即由內部派系戰引爆。阿布哈茲、南奧塞梯地面軍以當地民兵、原蘇軍徵召兵和志願兵為骨幹；俄軍的重裝、火力與航空支援則來自摩步師所屬坦克團、炮兵營和直升機營。
countriesEn: The belligerents fall into four layers. At the centre is the Republic of Georgia, which declared independence on 9 April 1991, together with the central government led by President Zviad Gamsakhurdia. At the regional level are the Autonomous Oblast of South Ossetia, which declared autonomy or independence in December 1991, and the Autonomous Republic of Abkhazia, which formally seceded on 26 August 1992. The external layer is the Russian Federation's 62nd and 64th Armies of the Transcaucasian Military District, which entered South Ossetia on 15 March 1992 and captured Tskhinvali, then returned to Abkhazia in September 1992 under the pretext of escorting supply corridors. The innermost layer is the struggle for power inside Georgia, in which the Interior Ministry police, the National Guard known as the Guardian of the Nation, and presidential supporters confronted one another; the clashes in the capital on 23–24 December 1993 grew out of this internal contest. Abkhaz and South Ossetian ground forces rested on local militia, former Soviet conscripts and volunteers, while Russian armor, artillery and aviation support came from the tank, artillery and helicopter battalions of the motor rifle divisions.
people: 主要人物：總統茲維亞德·加姆薩胡利亞1991年5月當選、10月14日就職，一面要求俄軍撤境，一面以國民警衛隊整編散兵；其堂弟戈吉·加姆薩胡利亞任國家守護者總指揮，第比利斯方面還有賈巴·約瑟利亞尼以武裝介入政治。前總統、外高加索籍的弗拉季斯拉夫·阿爾津巴1991年11月下台，1992年8月談判破裂後返回阿布哈茲，1999年出任阿布哈茲總統；分離派前期由海軍上校德米特里·阿拉克巴代表，1992年後由瓦列里·阿納克瓦卜主政，阿布哈茲首任總統為拉烏爾·哈吉姆巴。南奧塞梯代表人物是阿克巴爾·比比洛夫。俄軍方面，第64集團軍司令為維克托·格里科中將，高加索軍區司令為伊戈爾·羅多博爾斯基中將。格魯吉亞軍總司令阿米爾汗·塞比主持1993年兩度反攻阿布哈茲。1993年9月連察與拉片山一線的兵變由弗拉基米爾·察拉澤中尉帶動。1993年10月當選議會議長、12月21日出任代總統的愛迪華·謝爾韋德納澤，隨後取代加姆薩胡利亞。
peopleEn: The principal figures: President Zviad Gamsakhurdia, elected in May 1991 and inaugurated on 14 October, demanded a Russian withdrawal while consolidating scattered armed men into the National Guard. His cousin General Gogi Gamsakhurdia commanded the Guardian of the Nation, and in Tbilisi Jaba Ioseliani used armed force to intervene in politics. Vladislav Ardzinba, the former president, left office in November 1991 and, after talks broke down in August 1992, returned to Abkhazia, where he became president in 1999. The separatists were first represented by naval captain Dmitri Arakba and from 1992 were governed by Valeri Ankvab, while the first president of Abkhazia was Raul Khajimba. Akbar Bibilov was the leading South Ossetian representative. On the Russian side, the 64th Army was commanded by Lieutenant General Viktor Greko and the Transcaucasian Military District by Lieutenant General Igor Rodobolsky. Amirkhan Sebi, chief of the Georgian armed forces, directed the two Georgian offensives into Abkhazia in 1993. The mutiny at Lentekhi and in the Rati mountains in September 1993 was led by Lieutenant Vladimir Tsuladze. Eduard Shevardnadze, elected chairman of parliament in October 1993 and acting president on 21 December, then displaced Gamsakhurdia.
kits: 雙方武器幾乎同源，皆為1980年代蘇軍制式。步兵以AK-74、AKS-74與AKM突槍為主，機槍有PKM、DShK，格魯吉亞民兵常在AKM上加掛GP-25榴彈發射器，並使用RPG-7、RPG-16火箭筒、SVD Dragunov狙擊槍與RGD-5手榴彈。裝甲有T-72、T-72B坦克，BMP-1、BMP-2步兵戰車，BTR-60、BTR-70、BTR-80輸送車，以及GAZ-66、Ural-375D、ZIL-131卡車。火炮有2B14「Podnos」122毫米迫擊砲（1968年制式）、2S1「Gvozdika」122毫米自行火炮（1976年）、2S3「Akatsiya」152毫米自行榴彈砲（1975年）、2A36「Giatsint」152毫米線膛榴彈砲、BM-21「Grad」火箭炮（1969年）、9P140與9P140-1「Uragan」多管火箭炮（1972、1977年），俄軍另可調用2S19「Msta-S」152毫米自行榴彈砲（1989年制式）。航空主力是Mi-8、Mi-8MT與Mi-24「Hind」直升機、Mi-26重型直升機，1991年前已列裝的固定翼對地攻擊機只有Su-25「Frogfoot」，其可靠作戰記錄有限。第42近衛摩步師與第216摩步師配備T-72B與BMP-2，並有BM-21與9P140-1火箭炮營隨師作戰。後勤上，格魯吉亞以第比利斯與哥里為樞紐，靠Ural-375D、ZIL-131、GAZ-66沿第比利斯至茨欣瓦利公路輸送7.62×39毫米、5.45×39毫米步槍彈、12.7毫米重機槍彈、122毫米迫擊砲彈與152毫米炮彈，油料與備件多在出發地補給；俄軍則可利用師屬油料車隊與軍用公路網維持縱隊補給。
kitsEn: Weapons on both sides were essentially identical, drawn from Soviet standard issue of the 1980s. Infantry fought with AK-74, AKS-74 and AKM assault rifles, with PKM and DShK machine guns; Georgian militia commonly fitted AKM with the GP-25 grenade launcher and also used RPG-7 and RPG-16 launchers, the SVD Dragunov sniper rifle and RGD-5 grenades. Armor consisted of T-72 and T-72B tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60, BTR-70 and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, and GAZ-66, Ural-375D and ZIL-131 trucks. Artillery included the 2B14 Podnos 122mm mortar (in standard use from 1968), the 2S1 Gvozdika 122mm self-propelled gun (1976), the 2S3 Akatsiya 152mm self-propelled howitzer (1975), the 2A36 Giatsint 152mm towed howitzer, the BM-21 Grad rocket launcher (1969), and the 9P140 and 9P140-1 Uragan multiple rocket launchers (1972 and 1977); the Russians could also bring in the 2S19 Msta-S 152mm self-propelled howitzer, in service from 1989. The aviation mainstays were Mi-8, Mi-8MT and Mi-24 Hind helicopters and the Mi-26 heavy transport helicopter; the only fixed-wing ground attack type already in service before 1991 was the Su-25 Frogfoot, for which reliable combat records are scarce. The 42nd Guards and 216th Motor Rifle Divisions fielded T-72B and BMP-2 and fought with BM-21 and 9P140-1 rocket launcher battalions attached to the division. Logistically, Georgia used Tbilisi and Gori as hubs, moving 7.62x39mm and 5.45x39mm rifle ammunition, 12.7mm heavy machine gun ammunition, 122mm mortar bombs and 152mm shells along the Tbilisi–Tskhinvali road in Ural-375D, ZIL-131 and GAZ-66 vehicles, with fuel and spare parts replenished at the point of departure; the Russians sustained their columns using division fuel truck units and the military road network.
tactics: 南奧塞梯戰線自1991年底起就沿一條幹線展開：第比利斯至茨欣瓦利公路，以及茨欣瓦利至羅基公路通往俄羅斯邊境的高加索公路。格魯吉亞以坦克營加步兵營沿公路晝夜行軍推進，步兵下車後在峽谷地形遭民兵伏擊，RPG-7與迫擊砲是主要傷亡來源；俄軍與南奧塞梯民兵則利用公路兩側高地俯瞰射界，以第42近衛摩步師的裝甲與炮兵反擊。1992年3月15日俄軍先頭部隊與民兵攻入茨欣瓦利；4月20日至21日格魯吉亞由約瑟利亞尼指揮混合部隊試圖收復，裝甲縱隊在市北高地上被擊退，市區幾近全毀。6月17日至19日格魯吉亞再以國民警衛隊與主力部隊企圖切斷茨欣瓦利至羅基公路，因未能控制道路而撤回。阿布哈茲方面，1992年8月14日格軍穿越科多里峽谷，16日占領蘇呼米，16日至18日遭阿布哈茲民兵與俄軍反擊，撤退時炸毀塔梅什鐵路橋延緩追擊；9月俄軍進入後，阿布哈茲部隊在炮兵與航空支援下於10月18日重奪蘇呼米。1993年3月與8月格魯吉亞兩度反攻，分別在科多里峽谷、塔梅什、沙姆希利受阻；狹窄地形中的坦克縱隊損失慘重，格軍深入峽谷後補給線超過百公里，燃料與122毫米迫擊砲彈難以接續，部分單位在推進途中即停滯，8月戰役至9月初才完全撤出。
tacticsEn: The South Ossetian front unfolded from late 1991 along a single artery: the Tbilisi–Tskhinvali road and the Tskhinvali–Roki road leading to the Russian border and the Caucasus highway. Georgian forces advanced day and night along the road with tank and infantry battalions; dismounted infantry was ambushed in the ravines, where the RPG-7 and mortars produced most casualties, while Russian troops and South Ossetian militia used the high ground flanking the road for observation and brought counterfire from the armor and artillery of the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division. On 15 March 1992 a Russian vanguard and militia entered Tskhinvali; on 20–21 April a mixed force under Ioseliani tried to retake the city, its armored column being driven back from the heights north of town, which was left almost totally destroyed. On 17–19 June Georgian National Guard and regular units attempted to sever the Tskhinvali–Roki road and withdrew without ever securing it. In Abkhazia, Georgian troops crossed the Kodori gorge on 14 August 1992 and took Sukhumi on the 16th, but Abkhaz militia and Russian forces counterattacked on the 16th to 18th and the retreating Georgians blew up the railway bridge at Tamysh to delay pursuit; after Russian troops entered in September, Abkhaz units with artillery and air support retook Sukhumi on 18 October. The Georgian offensives of March and August 1993 were halted in the Kodori gorge and at Tamysh and Shamkhili; tank columns in narrow ground suffered heavily, and once the columns pushed more than a hundred kilometers deep their supply line stretched past one hundred kilometers, fuel and 122mm mortar bombs could not be sustained, and some units stalled in mid-advance until the fighting was finally drawn out by early September.
data: 關鍵日期與數字：1991年3月20日獨立公投，投票率約七成，支持獨立者逾九成九；5月26日加姆薩胡利亞當選總統；10月14日就職；12月南奧塞梯與阿布哈茲相繼宣布脫離；1992年3月15日茨欣瓦利失守；4月20日至21日收復戰失敗；8月14日格軍入阿布哈茲、8月16日占蘇呼米；8月26日阿布哈茲宣布獨立；9月俄軍進入阿布哈茲；10月18日蘇呼米易手；1993年3月與8月兩次反攻失敗；12月23日至24日第比利斯衝突，12月31日加姆薩胡利亞離境。距離上，第比利斯至茨欣瓦利公路約150公里，茨欣瓦利至羅基隧道約50公里，科多里峽谷口距蘇呼米約70公里，塔梅什在蘇呼米西北約45公里，格魯吉亞各部隊常用的通用道路寬度僅容單車隊縱列通過。兵力方面，1992年8月入阿布哈茲的格魯吉亞部隊常被估為二千至五千人，1993年8月反攻投入約五千至一萬人。陣亡數字各來源差異極大：南奧塞梯戰役雙方多落在數百至上千的量級；1993年8月阿布哈茲戰役中格魯吉亞軍損失最重，常被引述的估計自數百至逾兩千不等；阿布哈茲與南奧塞梯方面的統計更不完整。
dataEn: Key dates and figures: the independence referendum of 20 March 1991 drew a turnout of roughly seventy percent with more than ninety-nine percent in favour; Gamsakhurdia was elected president on 26 May and inaugurated on 14 October; in December South Ossetia and Abkhazia declared their separation; Tskhinvali fell on 15 March 1992; the attempt to retake it failed on 20–21 April; Georgian troops entered Abkhazia on 14 August and took Sukhumi on the 16th; Abkhazia declared independence on 26 August; Russian forces entered Abkhazia in September; Sukhumi changed hands on 18 October; the Georgian offensives of March and August 1993 were repelled; clashes erupted in Tbilisi on 23–24 December and Gamsakhurdia left the country on 31 December. In terms of distance, the road from Tbilisi to Tskhinvali is about 150 km, from Tskhinvali to the Roki tunnel about 50 km, the mouth of the Kodori gorge lies roughly 70 km from Sukhumi, and Tamysh is some 45 km north-west of Sukhumi, the usable Georgian roads being narrow enough for single-file columns. Troop strengths are often estimated at two to five thousand Georgian troops for the August 1992 entry into Abkhazia, with the larger August 1993 offensive putting perhaps five to ten thousand men in the field. Casualty figures vary enormously: in the South Ossetian war both sides are usually placed in the hundreds to low thousands; the Georgian losses in the August 1993 Abkhaz fighting were the heaviest, with estimates cited from several hundred to more than two thousand; the Abkhaz and South Ossetian counts are even less completely recorded.
cause: 成因為四股力量交會。其一，蘇聯解體後喬治亞中央政權失去對外高加索的行政與邊防壟斷，1990年主權宣言與1991年4月獨立宣告又缺乏國際承認與軍力支撐。其二，1989年以來民族主義動員把南奧塞梯、阿布哈茲的自治地位爭議變成主權問題，1991年12月兩地相繼宣布自治或獨立，中央軍與民兵隨即開火。其三，俄羅斯視高加索為戰略方向，保留第62、第64集團軍並以護送走廊、維護族際安全為名干預，使分離派獲得重裝、炮兵與航空支援。其四，喬治亞內部權力競逐：加姆薩胡利亞以國家守護者擴張軍權，與議會、內務部及謝爾韋德納澤派系互不信任；1991年春前總理努格扎爾·斯瓦尼澤與莫斯科簽訂軍事合作條約並引俄軍入境的作法，使中央軍在體系與士氣上先天受損，國民警衛隊與正規軍混編、指揮統一性不足，1993年8月的大規模反攻因此在後勤與協同上先天不足。
causeEn: Four forces converged to produce the war. First, with the dissolution of the Soviet Union the Georgian central government lost its administrative and border control over the Transcaucasus, and the sovereignty declaration of 1990 and the independence proclamation of April 1991 lacked international recognition and military support. Second, the nationalist mobilization since 1989 turned disputes over the autonomous status of South Ossetia and Abkhazia into questions of sovereignty; when both declared autonomy or independence in December 1991, regular troops and militia opened fire. Third, Russia treated the Caucasus as a strategic axis, retained the 62nd and 64th Armies, and intervened under the pretext of escorting corridors and protecting inter-ethnic safety, giving the separatists heavy armor, artillery and air support. Fourth, there was a struggle for power inside Georgia: Gamsakhurdia expanded military authority through the Guardian of the Nation while distrusting parliament, the Interior Ministry and Shevardnadze's faction; the military cooperation treaty signed with Moscow by former prime minister Nugzar Svanidze in the spring of 1991 and the introduction of Russian troops into Georgia weakened the central army's cohesion and morale, and the mixture of National Guard volunteers with regular units left command unity deficient, so the large-scale offensive of August 1993 was flawed from the start in logistics and coordination.
impact: 影響可分軍政與經濟兩面。軍政上，1992至1993年的實戰顯示格魯吉亞以志願兵、國民警衛隊與正規軍混編作戰時，必須依賴道路補給、夜間行軍分散與工兵排雷，否則裝甲縱隊在狹窄地形中會被火箭筒、迫擊砲與地雷吃掉；俄軍則證明只要掌握道路與火力即可左右戰局，並長期駐紮第216摩步師，第103、104摩托步兵團駐古利與古達烏塔、第24近衛摩托步兵旅駐奧查姆切雷，使分離派陣地得以鞏固，同時也讓格魯吉亞再無縱深可退。經濟上，貫穿南奧塞梯與阿布哈茲的鐵路與巴庫至諾沃羅西斯克原油管線多處中斷，首都的燃料、糧食與建材供應長期吃緊，阿布哈茲港的航運與黑海沿岸的旅遊收入近乎停擺。此後喬治亞的外交與軍事都向西方傾斜：1993年10月後啟動美國軍事援助計畫，1994年加入北約和平夥伴關係，但邊界與軍力失衡的問題未解。
impactEn: The impact divides into military-political and economic dimensions. Militarily, the fighting of 1992–1993 showed that Georgian operations mixing volunteers, National Guard and regular troops had to rely on road-bound supply, dispersed night movement and engineer clearance of mines, or armored columns would be destroyed in narrow terrain by rocket launchers, mortars and mines. The Russians demonstrated that control of roads and of firepower alone could decide a battle, and they garrisoned the 216th Motor Rifle Division for the long term, with the 103rd and 104th Motor Rifle Regiments at Gali and Gudauta and the 24th Guards Motor Rifle Brigade at Ochamchire, so the separatist positions were consolidated while Georgia was left without strategic depth. Economically, the railway and the Baku–Novorossiysk crude pipeline running through South Ossetia and Abkhazia were cut in many places, fuel, food and building materials were scarce in the capital for long periods, and shipping through the port of Sukhumi and tourism on the Black Sea coast came close to a halt. Georgia's diplomacy and military structure then tilted toward the West: a US military assistance programme was launched after October 1993 and Georgia joined NATO's Partnership for Peace in 1994, though the border and force-balance problems remained unresolved.
result: 結局是格魯吉亞未能以軍事手段解決兩地問題。南奧塞梯與阿布哈茲分別在1991至1992年脫離控制，1993年兩次反攻失敗後，加姆薩胡利亞於12月31日離境，1994年新憲法建立強勢總統制，1995年大選由謝爾韋德納澤主導，國家轉向談判路線。1998年蘇呼米議定書與2008年梅茲日比什基參數，使兩個實體的地位與俄軍駐紮獲得國際承認的框架，格魯吉亞則保有其餘領土與國際邊界，但承認兩地事實獨立等同承認領土損失。就戰役本身而言，其結果是：加姆薩胡利亞政權垮台，格魯吉亞軍隊在峽谷地形中的攻堅能力被證偽，而俄羅斯以最低的介入代價取得南奧塞梯與阿布哈茲的軍事通道與基地網。
resultEn: The outcome was that Georgia could not resolve the two territories by military means. South Ossetia and Abkhazia broke away in 1991–1992, and after two failed offensives in 1993 Gamsakhurdia left on 31 December. A new constitution in 1994 established a strong presidency, the 1995 election was dominated by Shevardnadze, and the country turned to negotiation. The 1998 Sukhumi Protocol and the 2008 Medzhybizhsky parameters framed the status of both entities and the Russian military presence in international terms, while Georgia retained the rest of its territory and its international borders, though recognizing de facto independence of the two regions amounted to accepting territorial loss. As for the campaign itself, the results were the collapse of the Gamsakhurdia regime, the demonstration that Georgian armor could not conduct deliberate assaults through gorge terrain, and Russia's acquisition of military corridors and a base network in South Ossetia and Abkhazia at the lowest possible cost of intervention.
